p.span: An enterprise architectural breakdown solving vector database scaling and compliance challenges in FinTech. Covers logarithmic HNSW retrieval, Matryoshka dimensionality reduction (truncating 3072d to 1536d to respect hardware constraints), and in-database JSONB RBAC filtering (?|) against Auth0 JWT claims to eliminate multi-tenant data leakage.
